executors.description: Produce a static canvas from a persisted design document through a package-owned preflight, validation, render, and inspection workflow. The model supplies design decisions as data; it does not author a full renderer.

actions.description: Record Pillow availability and a CJK-safe font profile once before authoring a canvas design document.
actions.result: An agentloop.canvasRuntimeProfile/v1 report with the reusable font and renderer readiness facts.

actions.description: Validate the persisted canvas design document before rendering. It checks the brief contract, normalized layout regions, explicit art direction, and output path.

inputs.name: design-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path of the agentloop.canvasDesignDocument/v1 JSON document.

actions.description: Render the validated document with the package-owned canvas scaffold. It writes the document-declared PNG and reports artifact facts; use this instead of writing a whole Pillow renderer.

inputs.name: design-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path of the validated agentloop.canvasDesignDocument/v1 JSON document.

actions.result: An agentloop.canvasDesignProductionReceipt/v1 receipt with the PNG path, dimensions, font profile, and brief-contract mapping.

actions.description: Inspect the rendered PNG against the persisted document: image decode, dimensions, mandatory-copy mapping, section regions, and clear reserved zones. It is not a substitute for final visual review.

inputs.name: design-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path of the agentloop.canvasDesignDocument/v1 JSON document used to render the image.

actions.result: An agentloop.canvasDesignInspection/v1 report with structural image and brief-contract facts.
